description.plain:
Friday, April 3, 2026
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000014Btx2AE/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for the first full moon hike of the 2026 season! We will travel 2-3 miles over easy to moderate terrain along Asnebumskit Hill in Paxton, MA. The pace will be easy to moderate. Expect to be on trail for a few hours. Enjoy views of the surrounding hills as we wind through forest lined with stone walls and dotted with brooks. Elevation gain is under 500 feet.Enjoy a Friday night with outdoor friends new and old.And... TRAIL CULT PRESENTS!!!An on-trail Cryptid history lesson! Coming to you live, the story of the Man, the Moth, the Legend... MOTHMAN!!!Just what happened in Point Pleasant, West Virginia in 1967? What does Dustin Hoffman have to do with it? And how does a 7-foot tall, anthropomorphized, bug man become a gay icon? All that and more!!!

events.summary: 20s & 30s Social at Start Line Brewing Co.

description.plain:
Thursday, April 9, 2026 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001310b2AA/
Join us for the April edition of the Worcester 20s & 30s monthly social series! We will be at Start Line Brewing Company in Hopkinton, MA on Thursday, April 9th starting at 6pm, but feel free to come whenever is convienent for you. Named after being less than a mile away from the start line of the Boston Marathon, Start Line Brewing has a variety of food, beer, and non-alcoholic options available. This is a great event for newcomers and returners alike - information will be available for upcoming trips as well as this being a good opportunity to connect with like-minded outdoorsy 20s & 30s folks. Hope to see you there!
